mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hotel (name, city, description, address, phone, star_level, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{city}, #{description}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{starLevel}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT id, name, city, description, address, phone, star_level, status, create_time FROM hotel
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND city = #{city}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
